newsitem.title: USA: U.S.'s Rubin back in U.S. for Treasury business.
newsitem.headline: U.S.'s Rubin back in U.S. for Treasury business.

text.p: U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin had cut short a trip to Mexico and returned to the U.S. to conduct regular Treasury business, Deputy Treasury Secretary Lawrence Summers told reporters on Wednesday.
"Secretary Rubin came back for regular Treasury business," Summers said.
Traders here speculated that Rubin's early return may be linked to reports of possible coordinated intervention among the United States, Japan and Germany.
Summers declined to comment on the possibility of any Group of Three coordinated intervention in the foreign exchange arena.
